Use this template only with your own authorized repository account. Do not paste
credentials, real rows, environment dumps, full private runs or sensitive exploit
details. There is no verified dedicated security-reporting channel yet: arrange
a safe route with the artifact provider/owner through an already verified private
channel before disclosing sensitive details. See the maintenance and security
handbook. This template assigns no maintainer or response deadline.

## Category and impact

- Category: installation / comprehension / semantics / integration / performance / evidence
- What real task is blocked? Is false `equivalent` suspected?
- Any safe workaround? Do not remove the gate or relax the contract to make it pass

## Minimal reproduction

Provide a small synthetic typed fixture, trusted commands/code/SQL, contract and
policy, budgets and repeatability. State the source of the independent expected
result. Explain any necessary sharing restriction; keep private details local.
